products.name: Beam Line Welding Machine / Pull-Through Welding Machine
products.shortDescription: Automated pull-through welding for H-beam and PEB fabrication, designed to support repeatable weld quality, organized production and reduced manual handling.

description.paragraph1:
The PAP Weld Core Beam Line Welding Machine, also known as a Pull-Through Welding Machine, is designed for structural steel fabrication, H-beam production and Pre-Engineered Building (PEB) manufacturing.
The system guides structural beam assemblies through a designated welding station using the feeding and support arrangements provided with the machine. Depending on the supplied configuration, the equipment may incorporate welding heads, drive mechanisms, guides and process controls to support organized production.
The machine's suitability depends on beam dimensions, material thickness, welding procedures, production requirements and the final approved configuration.
description.paragraph2:
1. Prepare and align the beam assembly.
2. Position the beam in the feeding arrangement.
3. Guide the assembly through the welding station.
4. Perform welding using the supplied equipment and approved procedure.
5. Inspect the completed beam against the applicable quality requirements.
The sequence depends on the machine design and welding configuration.

keyFeatures: Pull-through beam feeding arrangement for structured welding operations.
SAW-based welding configuration for suitable structural steel applications.
Support for specified H-beam dimensions and fabrication requirements.
Configurable beam-guiding and handling arrangements, depending on machine design.
Welding-process settings established according to the supplied equipment and approved welding procedure.
Designed to support repeatable production workflows and reduce repetitive manual handling where applicable.
Engineering assistance and Chennai-based support according to the agreed service terms.
applications: Steel Truss and Structural Assembly Manufacturing

products.name: CNC Flame / Plasma Cutting Machine
products.shortDescription: CNC flame and plasma cutting solution for industrial steel fabrication, delivering automated profile cutting, flexible material processing and production efficiency.

description.paragraph1:
The PAP Weld Core CNC Flame / Plasma Cutting Machine is an industrial CNC-controlled cutting solution designed for metal fabrication, structural steel processing and heavy engineering applications.

Combining computer-controlled motion with flame cutting and/or plasma cutting technology, the system is designed to process metal plates into specified profiles, shapes and components according to digital cutting programs.

The machine's gantry-based configuration supports controlled movement of the cutting equipment across the work area, helping manufacturers streamline cutting operations, improve dimensional repeatability and reduce reliance on manual marking and cutting.

With a stated effective cutting area of 3.3 × 12 metres, the machine is suited to large-format plate processing, subject to confirmation of the final machine configuration. Cutting capability depends on the selected process, power source, material type, thickness and operating parameters.

PAP Weld Core Automation Pvt. Ltd. provides industrial machinery solutions designed to meet practical fabrication requirements across structural steel manufacturing, infrastructure, heavy engineering and related industries.
description.paragraph2:
1. Digital Drawing and CNC Programming

The required component profile is prepared using compatible CAD/CAM software and converted into a CNC cutting program.

2. Plate Loading and Positioning

The metal plate is placed on the cutting table and positioned within the machine's effective working area using the appropriate material-handling arrangements.

3. Process Selection

The operator selects the suitable cutting process based on the material, thickness, profile requirements and available equipment.

Flame cutting: Uses fuel gas and oxygen to cut suitable ferrous materials, particularly carbon steel, including thicker plates.

Plasma cutting: Uses an electrically conductive, high-temperature plasma arc to cut electrically conductive metals, with capacity depending on the selected plasma power source.

4. CNC-Controlled Cutting

The gantry and cutting equipment follow the programmed toolpath to produce the required component profile. Appropriate cutting parameters and torch settings are selected according to the material and process.

5. Component Unloading and Inspection

After cutting, the components are removed and inspected for dimensional accuracy, edge quality and compliance with the fabrication drawing before moving to subsequent manufacturing operations.

Actual operating sequences, cutting performance, supported materials and available automation functions depend on the supplied machine configuration.
description.paragraph3:
Versatile Cutting Capability

A flame/plasma configuration can provide flexibility across different cutting applications when the selected equipment supports the required materials and thickness ranges.

Large-Format Plate Processing

The stated 3.3 × 12 m effective cutting area supports planning for large-format fabrication work, subject to confirmation of the final usable cutting dimensions.

CNC-Controlled Motion

Programmed gantry movement enables repeatable cutting paths and supports consistent component production when correctly calibrated and operated.

Improved Production Workflow

Digital cutting programs can help reduce repetitive manual layout work and organize the movement from design to finished component.

Application-Oriented Engineering

Machine configuration can be evaluated around plate dimensions, cutting requirements, production targets and the selected CNC and cutting equipment.

Designed for Industrial Fabrication

Suitable for evaluating cutting requirements across structural steel, heavy fabrication, industrial equipment manufacturing and infrastructure projects.

Technical and After-Sales Support

PAP Weld Core Automation Pvt. Ltd. can support customers according to the agreed scope of supply, installation, commissioning and service arrangements.

A Manufacturing-Focused Investment

The objective is to help fabricators improve cutting workflow organization, material utilization opportunities and production repeatability through CNC-based metal processing.

products.name: CNC Strip Cutting Machine
products.shortDescription: Industrial CNC flame strip cutting for steel plate processing, designed to produce consistent parallel strips and streamline structural fabrication workflows.

description.paragraph1:
A CNC Strip Cutting Machine is an industrial plate-processing system designed to cut large steel plates into straight, uniform strips according to specified dimensions and production requirements.
The PAP Weld Core CNC Strip Cutting Machine combines computer-controlled gantry movement with a configured flame-cutting system to support organized, repeatable strip-cutting operations in structural steel fabrication and heavy engineering environments.
By following programmed cutting paths, the machine helps streamline plate processing, reduce repetitive manual marking and support consistent strip dimensions when operated with appropriate cutting parameters, material positioning and machine calibration.
The machine can be configured around the customer's plate dimensions, required strip widths, material thickness, production volume and handling arrangements, subject to engineering feasibility and the agreed scope of supply.
With a stated cutting area of 3.3 × 12 metres and a listed maximum cutting thickness of 40 mm, the system is intended for large-format plate processing. These specifications must be confirmed against the approved technical datasheet before purchase or publication.
description.paragraph2:
1. Cutting Plan Preparation
The required strip widths and plate dimensions are defined from fabrication drawings or production requirements. A compatible CNC program is prepared using the supported programming workflow.
2. Plate Loading and Positioning
The steel plate is loaded onto the cutting table and positioned within the usable cutting area. Suitable support and alignment arrangements are used to establish the required cutting references.
3. CNC Program Setup
The operator verifies the cutting path, strip dimensions, torch settings and process parameters according to the material thickness and approved cutting procedure.
4. Controlled Flame Cutting
The gantry guides the configured cutting torch along the programmed paths. The machine cuts the plate into the required strips using suitable fuel gas, oxygen and cutting parameters.
5. Strip Removal and Quality Inspection
The cut strips are removed using appropriate material-handling equipment and inspected for dimensions, straightness and edge quality against the production requirements.
6. Downstream Fabrication
The processed strips are transferred to subsequent operations such as welding, beam fabrication, structural assembly or other suitable manufacturing processes.
The number of cutting torches, simultaneous cutting capability, automation functions and handling arrangements depend on the actual machine configuration.
description.paragraph3:
Production-Oriented Plate Processing
Supports organized conversion of large steel plates into strips for downstream fabrication, helping establish a structured production workflow.
CNC-Controlled Cutting Paths
Programmed gantry movement supports repeatable cutting operations when the machine is properly calibrated and operated within its specified capabilities.
Large-Format Processing Capability
The stated 3.3 × 12 m cutting area is intended to accommodate large plates, subject to verification of the effective working dimensions.
Reduced Manual Layout Work
CNC-based cutting programs can reduce repetitive manual marking and layout activities, depending on the production workflow.
Application-Specific Configuration
Machine requirements can be assessed against plate size, target strip widths, thickness range, cutting quality and production volume.
Integration with Fabrication Workflows
Processed strips can feed subsequent structural steel operations, including welding, assembly and component manufacturing.
Engineering-Led Equipment Selection
PAP Weld Core Automation Pvt. Ltd. can discuss application requirements, configuration options and the agreed scope of supply before quotation.
Commercial Clarity and Support
Installation, commissioning, operator training, warranty and after-sales services should be defined in the final commercial and technical proposal.
